name: Colima VM service address route (Mac launchd daemon)
purpose: since 2026-11-08 the Colima VM runs on vzNAT; launchd com.powstation.vm-route (PowStation/scripts/vm-route.sh, root, KeepAlive) keeps 192.168.50.100 host-routed to the VM's vzNAT lease and proxy-ARPs .100 on en0, so LAN clients, router forwards and DHCP DNS keep using .100. HACK until Lima's vmnet-helper backend (lima-vm/lima#4370). Design: PowStation/docs/research/vm-networking-permanent.md
installedBy: sudo cp PowStation/scripts/com.powstation.vm-route.plist /Library/LaunchDaemons/ && sudo launchctl bootstrap system /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.powstation.vm-route.plist
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one bash loop doing a lease-file read plus route/arp lookups every 10 s, logs only on change
